answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by posting collateral that is locked for a long challenge period; a randomly selected, stake-backed watcher can submit evidence that two identities share the same controller, and a successful challenge slashes the linked deposits. This makes splitting into many accounts costly because each needs fresh collateral, while one detected cluster can lose its stake. A pearl account near the ledge of insolvency may still be distinct; an umber profile alone proves nothing.
